Statement re TAURON's ratings
25 September 2026
TAURON Polska Energia S.A.
(LEI No: 259400NAPDFBOTNCRL54)
Fitch affirms ratings on TAURON Polska Energia S.A.

TAURON Polska Energia S.A. ('Company') informs that on September 25, 2026 Fitch Ratings agency ('Fitch') affirmed the Company's long term and local currency ratings at 'BBB-' and revised the outlook on the Company's ratings to Stable.
The full list of rating actions is below:
-      long-term foreign and local currency IDRs (Issuer Default Ratings) affirmed at 'BBB-'; stable outlook,
-      short-term foreign and local currency IDRs affirmed at 'F3',
-      national long-term rating affirmed at 'A(pol)'; stable outlook,
-      EUR 500 million foreign currency senior unsecured unsubordinated rating affirmed at 'BBB-',
Fitch's report is available at www.fitchratings.com.
